title: Webinar video and slides available: introducing the Bring Your Own Results (BYOR) service
summary: In our December 9, 2021 webinar we introduced and demonstrated our new "Bring Your Own Results" (BYOR) interactive interface.
bodyHtml:
In our December 9, 2021 webinar we introduced and demonstrated our new "Bring Your Own Results" (BYOR) interactive interface that allows researchers to showcase biomedical data in interactive tables and graphical visualizations, without the need for computer programming expertise.
